mapper.select:
/* AdminMenuMapper.selectMainMenuList */
SELECT am.uid , am.menu_code , am.link_url , am.title , am.color , am.top_margin FROM admin_menu am WHERE am.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND am.level = 1 AND am.display_in_menu = '1' ORDER BY am.display_ordinal ASC
SELECT t.uid , t.menu_code , t.link_url , t.title , t.color , t.top_margin , t.display_ordinal FROM ( SELECT am.uid , am.menu_code , am.link_url , am.title , am.color , am.top_margin , am.display_ordinal FROM admin_menu am JOIN admin_menu_permission amp ON ( (am.auth_code <> '' AND am.auth_code = amp.menu_code) OR (am.menu_code = amp.menu_code) ) WHERE am.level = 1 AND am.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND am.display_in_menu = '1' AND amp.worker_id = #{workerId} AND amp.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}'
UNION
SELECT am.uid , am.menu_code , am.link_url , am.title , am.color , am.top_margin , am.display_ordinal FROM admin_menu am WHERE am.level = 1 AND am.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND am.display_in_menu = '1' AND am.default_permission = '1' ) t ORDER BY t.display_ordinal ASC

/* AdminMenuMapper.selectSubMenuList */
SELECT am.uid , am.menu_code , am.parent_code , am.link_url , am.title , am.color FROM admin_menu am WHERE am.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND am.level = 2 AND am.display_in_menu = '1' ORDER BY am.display_ordinal ASC
SELECT t.uid , t.menu_code , t.parent_code , t.link_url , t.title , t.color , t.display_ordinal , (amb.menu_code IS NOT NULL) AS is_bookmark FROM ( SELECT am.uid , am.menu_code , am.parent_code , am.link_url , am.title , am.color , am.display_ordinal FROM admin_menu am JOIN admin_menu_permission amp ON ( (am.auth_code <> '' AND am.auth_code = amp.menu_code) OR (am.menu_code = amp.menu_code) ) WHERE am.level = 2 AND am.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND am.display_in_menu = '1' AND amp.worker_id = #{workerId} AND amp.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}'
UNION
SELECT am.uid , am.menu_code , am.parent_code , am.link_url , am.title , am.color , am.display_ordinal FROM admin_menu am WHERE am.level = 2 AND am.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND am.display_in_menu = '1' AND am.default_permission = '1' ) t LEFT JOIN admin_menu_bookmark amb ON amb.menu_code = t.menu_code AND amb.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND amb.worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY t.display_ordinal ASC

/* AdminMenuMapper.selectBookmarkList */
SELECT am.uid , am.menu_code , am.link_url , am.title , am.color , ((SELECT display_ordinal FROM admin_menu WHERE menu_code = am.parent_code AND level = 1) * 1000 + am.display_ordinal) AS bookmark_display_ordinal FROM admin_menu_bookmark amb JOIN admin_menu am ON am.menu_code = amb.menu_code WHERE am.level = 2 AND am.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND (am.display_in_menu = '1' OR am.tab_code <> '') AND amb.worker_id = #{workerId} AND amb.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' ORDER BY bookmark_display_ordinal ASC
SELECT t.uid , t.menu_code , t.link_url , t.title , t.color , (amb.menu_code IS NOT NULL) AS is_bookmark FROM ( SELECT am.uid , am.menu_code , am.link_url , am.title , am.color , ((SELECT display_ordinal FROM admin_menu WHERE menu_code = am.parent_code AND level = 1) * 1000 + am.display_ordinal) AS bookmark_display_ordinal FROM admin_menu_bookmark amb JOIN admin_menu am ON am.menu_code = amb.menu_code LEFT JOIN admin_menu_permission amp ON ( (am.auth_code <> '' AND am.auth_code = amp.menu_code) OR (am.menu_code = amp.menu_code) ) WHERE am.level = 2 AND am.on_service = '1' AND (am.display_in_menu = '1' OR am.tab_code <> '') AND amb.worker_id = #{workerId} AND amb.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND ( am.tab_code <> '' OR ( am.display_in_menu = '1' AND amp.worker_id = #{workerId} AND amp.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' ) )
UNION
SELECT am.uid , am.menu_code , am.link_url , am.title , am.color , ((SELECT display_ordinal FROM admin_menu WHERE menu_code = am.parent_code AND level = 1) * 1000 + am.display_ordinal) AS bookmark_display_ordinal FROM admin_menu_bookmark amb JOIN admin_menu am ON am.menu_code = amb.menu_code WHERE am.level = 2 AND am.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND (am.display_in_menu = '1' OR am.tab_code <> '') AND am.default_permission = '1' AND amb.worker_id = #{workerId} AND amb.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' ) t LEFT JOIN admin_menu_bookmark amb ON amb.menu_code = t.menu_code AND amb.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' AND amb.worker_id = #{workerId} ORDER BY t.bookmark_display_ordinal ASC

/* AdminMenuMapper.selectMenuTitle */ SELECT COALESCE(p.title, c.title) AS main_title , c.title AS sub_title , c.menu_code , c.parent_code FROM admin_menu c LEFT JOIN admin_menu p ON c.parent_code = p.menu_code AND p.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' WHERE c.link_url = #{linkUrl} AND c.on_service = '${@com.theloungemembers.core.type.ServiceStatus@IN_SERVICE.code}' LIMIT 1
